chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, that he saw Abu Ja'far (the second) (peace be upon him) throwing the stones while riding.
Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, that he saw Abu Ja'far (the second) (peace be upon him) throwing the stones while riding.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to throw the stones during Hajj while riding a camel or horse?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar records Sa'd ibn Abdillah witnessing Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) performing the stoning of the Jamarat while mounted, establishing a strong precedent for the permissibility of riding during the ritual. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a key evidence (hujjah) for the flexibility in Hajj rites, particularly for the elderly or those with physical difficulties, distinguishing it from the obligatory standing required by some other schools. The narration highlights the practical application of ease (rukhas) within the framework of the Prophet's household's practice.
